!90 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Issue 3872: SV_ShadingRate is accepted in hull and domain shader control-point\0A// signatures. The complaint is that DXC says nothing, so what you are looking for\0A// is an ABSENCE -- and an absence is only readable next to a control.\0A//\0A// This one file feeds five panes. Two compile positions the report says should be\0A// rejected; two are controls that put the same semantic, in the same stage, with\0A// the same compiler, into a position the interpretation table already marks NA.\0A//\0A//   1. dxc_trunk  -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain   the domain shader WRITES the rate.\0A//      ACCEPTED. Scroll to \22Output signature\22 and read the SysValue column of the\0A//      SV_ShadingRate row: it says SHDINGRATE, so this was lowered as a system\0A//      value, not quietly demoted to an arbitrary semantic. The D3D12 Variable\0A//      Rate Shading spec says the rate may be set from VS, GS or MS and \22It is\0A//      not permitted from other stages, for example DS\22.\0A//   2. dxc_trunk  -T ds_6_4 -E DSInBad     CONTROL, same compiler, same stage:\0A//      \22Semantic SV_ShadingRate is invalid for shader model: ds\22. So the check\0A//      exists and these command lines reach it. Pane 1's silence is a decision\0A//      recorded in a table, not a check that never ran.\0A//   3. dxc_trunk  -T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain  hull shader input control point.\0A//      ACCEPTED, same reading as pane 1 but in \22Input signature\22.\0A//   4. dxc_trunk  -T hs_6_4 -E HSPCOutBad  CONTROL for the hull stage.\0A//   5. dxc 1.6.2112  -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain   the release closest to the report\0A//      date. Same result: this is not a recent regression. Locally it also\0A//      reproduces on every release from 1.4.1907 onward.\0A//\0A// Not shown, and why: the DXIL validator does not catch it either -- dxv accepts\0A// all four containers, and both gates read the same SemanticInterpretation table.\0A// Clang trunk cannot be asked this question yet; it rejects the name outright with\0A// \22unknown HLSL semantic\22. FXC rejects it too, but it rejects it in the vertex\0A// shader as well, because the feature postdates Shader Model 5.1.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// Issue 3872 -- the source published to Compiler Explorer.\0A//\0A// It is repro.hlsl plus three CONTROL entry points, in one file, so that the\0A// link carries its own control: the same compiler, the same stage and the same\0A// semantic, once in a cell the interpretation table marks SV and once in a cell\0A// it marks NA. A link that only showed acceptance would be unreadable, because\0A// silence has an innocent explanation (nothing was checked) that a reader\0A// cannot rule out from the outside.\0A//\0A// What each pane compiles, and what to look at:\0A//\0A//   -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain    ACCEPTED. The D3D12 Variable Rate Shading spec\0A//                             says the rate may be set from VS, GS or MS and\0A//                             \22It is not permitted from other stages, for\0A//                             example DS\22. Look at the Output signature table:\0A//                             the row's SysValue column says SHDINGRATE, so\0A//                             this was lowered as a system value, not treated\0A//                             as an arbitrary semantic.\0A//   -T ds_6_4 -E DSInBad      CONTROL, same compiler and stage: DXC does have\0A//                             this diagnostic and does reach it here.\0A//   -T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain   ACCEPTED, hull shader input control point.\0A//   -T hs_6_4 -E HSPCOutBad   CONTROL, same compiler and stage.\0A//   dxc_1_6_2112 ds_6_4       The release closest to the report date, same\0A//                             result: this is not a recent regression.\0A//\0A// Locally this file is compiled by `triage.py run --shader godbolt-source.hlsl\0A// --label ce`, so the published source is not an untested variant of the repro.\0A\0Astruct VSOutRate {\0A  float4 pos : SV_Position;\0A  uint rate : SV_ShadingRate;\0A};\0A\0Astruct VSOutPlain {\0A  float4 pos : SV_Position;\0A  float2 uv : TEXCOORD0;\0A};\0A\0Astruct PatchConst {\0A  float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A  float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A};\0A\0A// The same struct with the rate moved into the patch-constant signature, which\0A// the table marks NA for both PCOut and DSIn.\0Astruct PatchConstSR {\0A  float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A  float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A  uint rate : SV_ShadingRate;\0A};\0A\0A// ---------------------------------------------------------------- accepted --\0A// SV_ShadingRate as a vertex shader output: permitted by the VRS spec, and the\0A// reason a reader can tell this build knows the semantic at all.\0AVSOutRate VSMain(float4 pos : POSITION, uint rate : RATE) {\0A  VSOutRate o;\0A  o.pos = pos;\0A  o.rate = rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0APatchConst PCMain(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip) {\0A  PatchConst c;\0A  c.edges[0] = 1;\0A  c.edges[1] = 1;\0A  c.edges[2] = 1;\0A  c.inside = 1;\0A  return c;\0A}\0A\0APatchConst PCMainRate(InputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> ip) {\0A  PatchConst c;\0A  c.edges[0] = 1;\0A  c.edges[1] = 1;\0A  c.edges[2] = 1;\0A  c.inside = 1;\0A  return c;\0A}\0A\0A// HSCPIn: the hull shader's INPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0A[partitioning(\22integer\22)]\0A[outputtopology(\22triangle_cw\22)]\0A[outputcontrolpoints(3)]\0A[patchconstantfunc(\22PCMainRate\22)]\0AVSOutPlain HSCPInMain(InputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> ip, uint i : SV_OutputControlPointID) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = ip[i].pos;\0A  o.uv = (float2)ip[i].rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// HSCPOut: the hull shader's OUTPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0A[partitioning(\22integer\22)]\0A[outputtopology(\22triangle_cw\22)]\0A[outputcontrolpoints(3)]\0A[patchconstantfunc(\22PCMain\22)]\0AVSOutRate HSCPOutMain(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip, uint i : SV_OutputControlPointID) {\0A  VSOutRate o;\0A  o.pos = ip[i].pos;\0A  o.rate = (uint)ip[i].uv.x;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// DSCPIn: the domain shader's INPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0AVSOutPlain DSCPInMain(PatchConst pc, float3 bary : SV_DomainLocation,\0A                      const OutputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> patch) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = patch[0].pos * bary.x + patch[1].pos * bary.y + patch[2].pos * bary.z;\0A  o.uv = (float2)patch[0].rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// DSOut: the domain shader WRITES SV_ShadingRate. This is the position the VRS\0A// spec rules out by name.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0AVSOutRate DSOutMain(PatchConst pc, float3 bary : SV_DomainLocation,\0A                    const OutputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> patch) {\0A  VSOutRate o;\0A  o.pos = patch[0].pos * bary.x + patch[1].pos * bary.y + patch[2].pos * bary.z;\0A  o.rate = (uint)patch[0].uv.x;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// ----------------------------------------------------------------- controls --\0A// The same semantic in three cells the same table already marks NA, so a reader\0A// can see the diagnostic exists and fires in these very stages.\0A\0A// VSIn is NA: expect \22invalid semantic 'SV_ShadingRate' for vs 6.4\22.\0AVSOutPlain VSInBad(float4 pos : POSITION, uint rate : SV_ShadingRate) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = pos;\0A  o.uv = (float2)rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0APatchConstSR PCMainBad(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip) {\0A  PatchConstSR c;\0A  c.edges[0] = 1;\0A  c.edges[1] = 1;\0A  c.edges[2] = 1;\0A  c.inside = 1;\0A  c.rate = 1;\0A  return c;\0A}\0A\0A// PCOut is NA: expect \22Semantic SV_ShadingRate is invalid for shader model: hs\22.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0A[partitioning(\22integer\22)]\0A[outputtopology(\22triangle_cw\22)]\0A[outputcontrolpoints(3)]\0A[patchconstantfunc(\22PCMainBad\22)]\0AVSOutPlain HSPCOutBad(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip, uint i : SV_OutputControlPointID) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = ip[i].pos;\0A  o.uv = ip[i].uv;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// DSIn is NA: expect \22Semantic SV_ShadingRate is invalid for shader model: ds\22.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0AVSOutPlain DSInBad(PatchConstSR pc, float3 bary : SV_DomainLocation,\0A                   const OutputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> patch) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = patch[0].pos * bary.x + patch[1].pos * bary.y + patch[2].pos * bary.z;\0A  o.uv = (float2)pc.rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A"}

!77 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Issue 3872: SV_ShadingRate is accepted in hull and domain shader control-point\0A// signatures. The complaint is that DXC says nothing, so what you are looking for\0A// is an ABSENCE -- and an absence is only readable next to a control.\0A//\0A// This one file feeds five panes. Two compile positions the report says should be\0A// rejected; two are controls that put the same semantic, in the same stage, with\0A// the same compiler, into a position the interpretation table already marks NA.\0A//\0A//   1. dxc_trunk  -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain   the domain shader WRITES the rate.\0A//      ACCEPTED. Scroll to \22Output signature\22 and read the SysValue column of the\0A//      SV_ShadingRate row: it says SHDINGRATE, so this was lowered as a system\0A//      value, not quietly demoted to an arbitrary semantic. The D3D12 Variable\0A//      Rate Shading spec says the rate may be set from VS, GS or MS and \22It is\0A//      not permitted from other stages, for example DS\22.\0A//   2. dxc_trunk  -T ds_6_4 -E DSInBad     CONTROL, same compiler, same stage:\0A//      \22Semantic SV_ShadingRate is invalid for shader model: ds\22. So the check\0A//      exists and these command lines reach it. Pane 1's silence is a decision\0A//      recorded in a table, not a check that never ran.\0A//   3. dxc_trunk  -T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain  hull shader input control point.\0A//      ACCEPTED, same reading as pane 1 but in \22Input signature\22.\0A//   4. dxc_trunk  -T hs_6_4 -E HSPCOutBad  CONTROL for the hull stage.\0A//   5. dxc 1.6.2112  -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain   the release closest to the report\0A//      date. Same result: this is not a recent regression. Locally it also\0A//      reproduces on every release from 1.4.1907 onward.\0A//\0A// Not shown, and why: the DXIL validator does not catch it either -- dxv accepts\0A// all four containers, and both gates read the same SemanticInterpretation table.\0A// Clang trunk cannot be asked this question yet; it rejects the name outright with\0A// \22unknown HLSL semantic\22. FXC rejects it too, but it rejects it in the vertex\0A// shader as well, because the feature postdates Shader Model 5.1.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// Issue 3872 -- the source published to Compiler Explorer.\0A//\0A// It is repro.hlsl plus three CONTROL entry points, in one file, so that the\0A// link carries its own control: the same compiler, the same stage and the same\0A// semantic, once in a cell the interpretation table marks SV and once in a cell\0A// it marks NA. A link that only showed acceptance would be unreadable, because\0A// silence has an innocent explanation (nothing was checked) that a reader\0A// cannot rule out from the outside.\0A//\0A// What each pane compiles, and what to look at:\0A//\0A//   -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain    ACCEPTED. The D3D12 Variable Rate Shading spec\0A//                             says the rate may be set from VS, GS or MS and\0A//                             \22It is not permitted from other stages, for\0A//                             example DS\22. Look at the Output signature table:\0A//                             the row's SysValue column says SHDINGRATE, so\0A//                             this was lowered as a system value, not treated\0A//                             as an arbitrary semantic.\0A//   -T ds_6_4 -E DSInBad      CONTROL, same compiler and stage: DXC does have\0A//                             this diagnostic and does reach it here.\0A//   -T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain   ACCEPTED, hull shader input control point.\0A//   -T hs_6_4 -E HSPCOutBad   CONTROL, same compiler and stage.\0A//   dxc_1_6_2112 ds_6_4       The release closest to the report date, same\0A//                             result: this is not a recent regression.\0A//\0A// Locally this file is compiled by `triage.py run --shader godbolt-source.hlsl\0A// --label ce`, so the published source is not an untested variant of the repro.\0A\0Astruct VSOutRate {\0A  float4 pos : SV_Position;\0A  uint rate : SV_ShadingRate;\0A};\0A\0Astruct VSOutPlain {\0A  float4 pos : SV_Position;\0A  float2 uv : TEXCOORD0;\0A};\0A\0Astruct PatchConst {\0A  float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A  float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A};\0A\0A// The same struct with the rate moved into the patch-constant signature, which\0A// the table marks NA for both PCOut and DSIn.\0Astruct PatchConstSR {\0A  float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A  float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A  uint rate : SV_ShadingRate;\0A};\0A\0A// ---------------------------------------------------------------- accepted --\0A// SV_ShadingRate as a vertex shader output: permitted by the VRS spec, and the\0A// reason a reader can tell this build knows the semantic at all.\0AVSOutRate VSMain(float4 pos : POSITION, uint rate : RATE) {\0A  VSOutRate o;\0A  o.pos = pos;\0A  o.rate = rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0APatchConst PCMain(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip) {\0A  PatchConst c;\0A  c.edges[0] = 1;\0A  c.edges[1] = 1;\0A  c.edges[2] = 1;\0A  c.inside = 1;\0A  return c;\0A}\0A\0APatchConst PCMainRate(InputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> ip) {\0A  PatchConst c;\0A  c.edges[0] = 1;\0A  c.edges[1] = 1;\0A  c.edges[2] = 1;\0A  c.inside = 1;\0A  return c;\0A}\0A\0A// HSCPIn: the hull shader's INPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0A[partitioning(\22integer\22)]\0A[outputtopology(\22triangle_cw\22)]\0A[outputcontrolpoints(3)]\0A[patchconstantfunc(\22PCMainRate\22)]\0AVSOutPlain HSCPInMain(InputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> ip, uint i : SV_OutputControlPointID) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = ip[i].pos;\0A  o.uv = (float2)ip[i].rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// HSCPOut: the hull shader's OUTPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0A[partitioning(\22integer\22)]\0A[outputtopology(\22triangle_cw\22)]\0A[outputcontrolpoints(3)]\0A[patchconstantfunc(\22PCMain\22)]\0AVSOutRate HSCPOutMain(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip, uint i : SV_OutputControlPointID) {\0A  VSOutRate o;\0A  o.pos = ip[i].pos;\0A  o.rate = (uint)ip[i].uv.x;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// DSCPIn: the domain !90 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Issue 3872: SV_ShadingRate is accepted in hull and domain shader control-point\0A// signatures. The complaint is that DXC says nothing, so what you are looking for\0A// is an ABSENCE -- and an absence is only readable next to a control.\0A//\0A// This one file feeds five panes. Two compile positions the report says should be\0A// rejected; two are controls that put the same semantic, in the same stage, with\0A// the same compiler, into a position the interpretation table already marks NA.\0A//\0A//   1. dxc_trunk  -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain   the domain shader WRITES the rate.\0A//      ACCEPTED. Scroll to \22Output signature\22 and read the SysValue column of the\0A//      SV_ShadingRate row: it says SHDINGRATE, so this was lowered as a system\0A//      value, not quietly demoted to an arbitrary semantic. The D3D12 Variable\0A//      Rate Shading spec says the rate may be set from VS, GS or MS and \22It is\0A//      not permitted from other stages, for example DS\22.\0A//   2. dxc_trunk  -T ds_6_4 -E DSInBad     CONTROL, same compiler, same stage:\0A//      \22Semantic SV_ShadingRate is invalid for shader model: ds\22. So the check\0A//      exists and these command lines reach it. Pane 1's silence is a decision\0A//      recorded in a table, not a check that never ran.\0A//   3. dxc_trunk  -T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain  hull shader input control point.\0A//      ACCEPTED, same reading as pane 1 but in \22Input signature\22.\0A//   4. dxc_trunk  -T hs_6_4 -E HSPCOutBad  CONTROL for the hull stage.\0A//   5. dxc 1.6.2112  -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain   the release closest to the report\0A//      date. Same result: this is not a recent regression. Locally it also\0A//      reproduces on every release from 1.4.1907 onward.\0A//\0A// Not shown, and why: the DXIL validator does not catch it either -- dxv accepts\0A// all four containers, and both gates read the same SemanticInterpretation table.\0A// Clang trunk cannot be asked this question yet; it rejects the name outright with\0A// \22unknown HLSL semantic\22. FXC rejects it too, but it rejects it in the vertex\0A// shader as well, because the feature postdates Shader Model 5.1.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// Issue 3872 -- the source published to Compiler Explorer.\0A//\0A// It is repro.hlsl plus three CONTROL entry points, in one file, so that the\0A// link carries its own control: the same compiler, the same stage and the same\0A// semantic, once in a cell the interpretation table marks SV and once in a cell\0A// it marks NA. A link that only showed acceptance would be unreadable, because\0A// silence has an innocent explanation (nothing was checked) that a reader\0A// cannot rule out from the outside.\0A//\0A// What each pane compiles, and what to look at:\0A//\0A//   -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain    ACCEPTED. The D3D12 Variable Rate Shading spec\0A//                             says the rate may be set from VS, GS or MS and\0A//                             \22It is not permitted from other stages, for\0A//                             example DS\22. Look at the Output signature table:\0A//                             the row's SysValue column says SHDINGRATE, so\0A//                             this was lowered as a system value, not treated\0A//                             as an arbitrary semantic.\0A//   -T ds_6_4 -E DSInBad      CONTROL, same compiler and stage: DXC does have\0A//                             this diagnostic and does reach it here.\0A//   -T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain   ACCEPTED, hull shader input control point.\0A//   -T hs_6_4 -E HSPCOutBad   CONTROL, same compiler and stage.\0A//   dxc_1_6_2112 ds_6_4       The release closest to the report date, same\0A//                             result: this is not a recent regression.\0A//\0A// Locally this file is compiled by `triage.py run --shader godbolt-source.hlsl\0A// --label ce`, so the published source is not an untested variant of the repro.\0A\0Astruct VSOutRate {\0A  float4 pos : SV_Position;\0A  uint rate : SV_ShadingRate;\0A};\0A\0Astruct VSOutPlain {\0A  float4 pos : SV_Position;\0A  float2 uv : TEXCOORD0;\0A};\0A\0Astruct PatchConst {\0A  float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A  float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A};\0A\0A// The same struct with the rate moved into the patch-constant signature, which\0A// the table marks NA for both PCOut and DSIn.\0Astruct PatchConstSR {\0A  float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A  float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A  uint rate : SV_ShadingRate;\0A};\0A\0A// ---------------------------------------------------------------- accepted --\0A// SV_ShadingRate as a vertex shader output: permitted by the VRS spec, and the\0A// reason a reader can tell this build knows the semantic at all.\0AVSOutRate VSMain(float4 pos : POSITION, uint rate : RATE) {\0A  VSOutRate o;\0A  o.pos = pos;\0A  o.rate = rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0APatchConst PCMain(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip) {\0A  PatchConst c;\0A  c.edges[0] = 1;\0A  c.edges[1] = 1;\0A  c.edges[2] = 1;\0A  c.inside = 1;\0A  return c;\0A}\0A\0APatchConst PCMainRate(InputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> ip) {\0A  PatchConst c;\0A  c.edges[0] = 1;\0A  c.edges[1] = 1;\0A  c.edges[2] = 1;\0A  c.inside = 1;\0A  return c;\0A}\0A\0A// HSCPIn: the hull shader's INPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0A[partitioning(\22integer\22)]\0A[outputtopology(\22triangle_cw\22)]\0A[outputcontrolpoints(3)]\0A[patchconstantfunc(\22PCMainRate\22)]\0AVSOutPlain HSCPInMain(InputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> ip, uint i : SV_OutputControlPointID) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = ip[i].pos;\0A  o.uv = (float2)ip[i].rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// HSCPOut: the hull shader's OUTPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0A[partitioning(\22integer\22)]\0A[outputtopology(\22triangle_cw\22)]\0A[outputcontrolpoints(3)]\0A[patchconstantfunc(\22PCMain\22)]\0AVSOutRate HSCPOutMain(InputPatch<VSOutPlain, 3> ip, uint i : SV_OutputControlPointID) {\0A  VSOutRate o;\0A  o.pos = ip[i].pos;\0A  o.rate = (uint)ip[i].uv.x;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// DSCPIn: the domain shader's INPUT control point carries SV_ShadingRate.\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0AVSOutPlain DSCPInMain(PatchConst pc, float3 bary : SV_DomainLocation,\0A                      const OutputPatch<VSOutRate, 3> patch) {\0A  VSOutPlain o;\0A  o.pos = patch[0].pos * bary.x + patch[1].pos * bary.y + patch[2].pos * bary.z;\0A  o.uv = (float2)patch[0].rate;\0A  return o;\0A}\0A\0A// DSOut: the domain shader WRITES SV_ShadingRate.
